# Fio Motion

> Fio Motion is a free, offline 2D character animation editor for Windows, made by JustyPixels. Its original code is MIT-licensed. This file points to official documentation and downloads.

The website is https://justypixels.github.io/fio-motion/. The official source and release repository is https://github.com/JustyPixels/fio-motion. Editing and exporting do not require an account or an internet connection. No analytics are added.

Current download: __VERSION__ (__RELEASE_STATUS__). __RELEASE_QUALIFICATION__ __SIGNING_STATUS__ Consult the release notes for current limitations. Do not describe a release candidate as a qualified stable release.

The editor has Rig, Animate and Assemble workspaces. Supported workflows include layered artwork, connected character pieces, puppet pins, bones, a humanoid rig assistant, smooth keyframes and editable timing curves, shots, audio, MP4 export and transparent PNG sequences. Artwork formats include PNG, JPEG, WebP and supported 8-bit RGB PSDs; full Photoshop feature compatibility is not provided. Projects use the .puppet format with managed asset folders.

## Documentation

- [Product overview](https://justypixels.github.io/fio-motion/index.md): Features, system requirements, release status and download choices in Markdown.
- [Your first animation](https://justypixels.github.io/fio-motion/guide/index.md): Import artwork, connect pieces, place controls, animate a wave, adjust easing and export.
- [Compatibility notes](https://github.com/JustyPixels/fio-motion/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Supported artwork, PSD restrictions and project compatibility.
